feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 November 2026 4:17pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 11 November 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the south of Iceland and a deepening area of low pressure running south into the North Sea.


##Wind##

North or northwest 2 to 4, veering and increasing northerly 4 or 5 through this evening and reaching force 6 in the west of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate in the west and south of the area overnight.


##Weather##

Generally fair, but with a few isolated showers in the west overnight.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northerly 4 or 5, perhaps 6 in the west at first, backing northwest 3 or 4 Friday morning, backing west or northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west at first.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
